body:
Greg's direction, 2026-11-16 ~16:58Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant in TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1915. Greg, verbatim: „Jakis koszmar. Przeciez mamy reguly aby uzywac tylko katalogu repo.” This came after ~40 GiB was found under ~/.termal/delegations: TermAl's default isolated-worktree location, never cleaned up, plus 1,134 worktrees leaked there by tests.
The rule: delegation worktrees, their target/ and all test data are created INSIDE the right repository, never by default in ~/.termal/delegations, and host tests never write to the real ~/.termal.
INTERIM, until w-eb21094eba5a lands: anyone spawning an isolated-worktree worker delegation passes an explicit worktree path inside the source repo's .tmp/. The no-path default is forbidden. Read-only delegations create no worktree.
Existing folders there are deleted or moved only with Greg's word and an owner check: TermAl's by Opus2, Engram's by Engram::Fable's team. Fix owners: Opus3 for w-eb21 and w-26abac74c80a.

CORRECTION, 2026-11-16 ~17:00Z. The interim "explicit path inside .tmp/" is IMPOSSIBLE: the running host refuses any isolated-worktree path inside the source repo (src/delegations.rs:4664-4670, found by Opus3). The interim rule is now: NO isolated-worktree delegations at all until w-eb21094eba5a lands. Authors work as root sessions in their own in-repo .tmp/wt-* worktrees. Engram follows the same rule. The default agreed for the fix is <source repo root>/.worktrees/delegation-<id>.
